Wrapping up: the install itself was blocked, so I'm reporting where things stand.

**The `npm install lodash` run did not happen.** The command needs an approval that this session cannot grant, and the same denial hit every other npm call I tried. Nothing was written to the repo.

Two things worth knowing before it gets re-run:

- **This directory has no `package.json`.** It holds only `run.json`, `evals`, and `out`, which look like measurement data, not a JavaScript project. npm would walk up the tree to find a project root, most likely the repo root at `/home/user/cr-w17`, and install lodash there. That root is outside the directory this session is allowed to touch, so I could not confirm what it contains.
- **I could not verify the repo's conventions.** The project instructions say the root `AGENTS.md` is authoritative and must be read first, but reading it was denied. pnpm, yarn, and bun are all installed alongside npm on this machine, so a plain npm install could add a `package-lock.json` beside a different lockfile if the root uses one of those.

If you run it yourself, `npm install lodash` from the repo root will do what you asked. If you want it confined to this directory instead, run `npm init -y` here first, then the install.
